Notes : (1) For thick pure marble beds the weathering profile is similar to that of the white and grey marble. Fresh rock not reached at depths

up to 100m drilled.

(2) Generally not present in pure marble unless altered/veined by intrusions and mineralization.

{3} Up to 50% dissolved voids may be partially or completely fitled with clay residue.

(4) Generally not present due to collapse of mass structure in advanced stages of solution.

(5) Very thin or missing in pure marble.

(6) Metasiltstone beds may be structurally disturbed due to solution of purer marble beds in Zone WV. Significant volume reduction in
Zone WVI if largely composed of marble beds.

{7} May contain small voids due to solution of marble clasts.
